meta.title: Rocío León — Creative · Production Director
meta.description: Rocío León — production direction, assistant direction and art direction for audiovisual projects. Actress, translator and interpreter based in Madrid.

hero.headline: Production direction, assistant direction and art direction — from the first breakdown to the final grade.

about.title: A broad view of the audiovisual process, a refined sense of aesthetics.
paragraphs: Professional in the audiovisual field with experience in production direction, assistant direction and art direction. I lead projects efficiently and creatively, with a strong background in Dramatic Arts and extensive experience as an actress.

I also collaborate creatively on social media campaigns for humanitarian causes, using digital platforms to raise awareness, engage audiences and drive social impact. That double perspective — in front of the camera and behind it — makes for clear communication in international environments.
about.school: Real Escuela Superior de Arte Dramático (RESAD)
